The documented record item is getzonerecordResponseBase (Line, class, name, ttl, type) with a discriminator mapping on type to 19 per-type schemas (A, A6, AAAA, AFSDB, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, DNAME, DS, HINFO, LOC, MX, NS, PTR, RP, SOA, SRV, SSHFP, TXT) that add the record data fields; the generator reads only the base schema, so the base and every per-type field are merged into one object with every field optional (none is required upstream). Integers stay int, 0/1 enums (CAA flag, CNAME flatten, TXT unencoded) become flag, and everything else, including class and flatten_to, is a string.
getzonerecord returned record[].preference of an MX record as a decimal string, although the pinned MX schema declares an integer; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice
